name: Gmina Nowa Ruda (Poland)
description: Vertical tricolour of yellow, red and yellow in the ratio 1:2:1, the red charged with a yellow tree stump within a wreath of leaves, the charge from the gmina arms.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.

features.role: tree stump within a wreath of leaves, from the gmina arms
